description: A high-fidelity 3D Coin Pusher arcade simulation featuring dynamic physics, procedural slot machines, and particle effects.

scenes.description: Main gameplay scene containing the pusher table, coin spawning area, and dynamic UI overlay.

scripts.responsibility: Handles individual coin physics, type-based properties, and boundary/collection triggers.
Manages slot machine logic, dynamic billboard creation, and reward distribution.
Core game loop, score tracking, fever mode logic, and game state transitions.

humanSetupInstructions: Ensure TextMeshPro is installed in the project.
Attach 'GameManager.cs' and 'UIManager.cs' to an empty GameObject named 'GameManager'.
Attach 'CoinSpawner.cs' to the spawn point object and assign the Coin and Bumper prefabs.
Ensure the main camera has the 'MainCamera' tag for the CameraShake script to auto-attach.
Ensure all physical colliders for score/loss zones are set to 'Is Trigger'.
